title: c-VEP and Burst-VEP dataset from Castillos et al. (2023)
description: This dataset contains 32-channel EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing an offline 4-class code-modulated visual evoked potential (c-VEP) task. It compares novel burst c-VEP sequences with traditional m-sequences at 100% and 40% amplitude depth, in a factorial within-subject design. The data support evaluation of CNN-based decoding, classification accuracy with minimal calibration data, and user visual comfort in reactive brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a BrainProducts LiveAmp 32-channel system (Acticap active electrodes, FCz reference, FPz ground). Stimuli were presented with PsychoPy on a 60 Hz monitor. Participants focused on cued targets in 15 blocks of 4 trials. Burst and m-sequence codes were compared at two amplitude depths. Decoding used a CNN with 250 ms sliding windows and Pearson correlation for target selection.
